validity.recommendation: check the length: the company site and energypolicy say 105 km while a 2020 thesis says 115 km
validity.researcher_notes: The line from the Zapadno-Ozernoye field to Anadyr is in use and Sibneft-Chukotka runs it. Pipe is 219 mm. The company gives 105 km. A university thesis gives 115 km for the route. The sheet length was not part of this pass.

fills.researcher_notes: Two independent publishers agree. The Sibneft-Chukotka site says it carries the gas from the Zapadno-Ozernoye field unit to the Anadyr gas distribution station by a 105 km trunk line of 219 mm pipe. An energypolicy.ru article of June 2024, read as the Wayback capture of 8 July 2025, says the transport on the Zapadno-Ozernoye to Anadyr trunk line is provided by Sibneft-Chukotka LLC. The live energypolicy.ru address now redirects to the site home page.

Добываемая со скважин продукция подается по газопроводу длиной 115 км на Анадырскую газомоторную станцию

fills.researcher_notes: The company site describes the trunk line as part of its own production system. A 2020 Tomsk Polytechnic University thesis says the Zapadno-Ozernoye license and development belong to Sibneft-Chukotka and that the field gas goes through a gas line to Anadyr. Neither says ownership of the pipe in words and the thesis gives 115 km, not 105 km, so the tier is medium.

verifications.note: Транспорт природного газа осуществляется по герметизированному магистральному газопроводу

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The company site shows a 2026 copyright and describes the line as carrying gas now. The 2024 article agrees.

Names Sibneft-Chukotka as license holder and user of the field and says the field gas goes by a 115 km gas line to the Anadyr gas engine station. Used as secondary support for owner.
